flashcard_questions.q: A group of musicians who perform together, typically a small group rather than a full orchestra.
Music written for a small group of instruments, usually with one player per part, intended for intimate performance spaces.
The way in which musical parts or layers are combined in a piece of music.
Which texture has a single melodic line and no accompaniment?

flashcard_questions.a: A chamber music ensemble of three instruments, commonly piano, violin, and cello.
